lens: geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then lighting on the seats, then artefacts. Fabrics judged as photo-vs-render crops at a matched physical scale: the photo is downsampled to the render's px/m, using a 17 in (0.43 m) seat width as the ruler. Lighting and QA camera placement are noted but not scored. Working files are in /tmp/claude-0/raterB13/ (st.py, st2.py, st3.py, cmp_mos_diam.png, mos_photo.png, mos_r13.png, q15top.png, p00top.png).

priorIssues.issue: w12a-1 / w12b-1 dash mosaic reads as a brick wall with dark mortar
priorIssues.evidence: The dark seams are gone. But each block's dashes start 2 px inside the block and stop 2 px short of its right edge (make_swatches.py y_mosaic: xa = x0 + 2 ..., while xa < x0 + cw - 2, rows y0+1 .. y1-1), so empty channels still outline every block (mos_r13.png). The photo's dashes run on across the blocks (mos_photo.png). At a matched scale (y_47306 R crop downsampled to e4's ~465 px/m) the photo gives light/dark quartile ratio 2.58 and p90/p50 1.69. r13 e4 gives 1.93 and 1.44, so the contrast fell from r12's 2.12. The dashes are dim periwinkle (#50659d) where the photo's are near-white on deep navy (#0d1b4b dark quartile against r13 #263157).

priorIssues.issue: w12a-2 diamond: soft blobs on a strict lattice instead of crisp serrated stars
priorIssues.evidence: Otsu light area at 2 px blur: r13 e1 0.42 (r12 0.44) against y_47306 L 0.21. The 0.035-0.04 half-diagonals on the 1/3 quincunx lattice now touch, so the light part forms a continuous net. The figures read as hollow rings around small dark diamonds (cmp_mos_diam.png bottom), not solid stars on a blue ground.

priorIssues.issue: w12b-2 diamond too contrasty, ground too dark and grey
priorIssues.evidence: e1 diamond: light/dark 1.68 (photo 2.25, r12 2.77). Blur p80/p20 1.26 (photo 1.43, r12 1.66). Saturation 0.62 against 0.49 in the photo. Mean #35478c against #566cab. The ground hue is now right (#233273 vs #2d4281), but the figures sink into it.

priorIssues.issue: w12a-3 / w12b-3 head-on headrest covers as bright as the fabric
priorIssues.evidence: q15 cover/back median luminance per seat: 0.81 / 0.83 / 0.96 / 0.97 (r12 0.91-1.15). y_47300: 0.69 / 0.87 / 0.55 / 0.72. The cover L50 is 65-75 against a photo mean of ~51. Seats 3 and 4 still read mid-tone, not as the dark rectangles of y_47300.

priorIssues.issue: w12a-4 tick columns too weak at row distance; close-up darks too deep
priorIssues.evidence: q15 tick backs resampled to y_47300 scale (x0.676): column CV 0.088 / 0.104 (r12 0.110) against 0.163 / 0.209 in the photo. p10/p50 is 0.62-0.64 against 0.43-0.45. The dark lift added in w12 (r + 0.25*(mean - r)) erased the channels that carry the columns at row distance. Close up (e4 vs y_47306 M at the same scale) the dark quartile is #18244f against photo #182b67, now right. Light/dark is 2.57 against 3.14, and the light ticks are greyish (#657291) where the photo's are a vivid pale blue (#92a6df). The photo's column period, measured by FFT, is 13-14 mm, so the 15.5 mm envelope is about right.

priorIssues.issue: w12a-5 seat pans pale and desaturated
priorIssues.status: fixed for tick pans; petal pans still pale
priorIssues.evidence: Tick pans: B/R 1.81 (e7) and 1.78 (e1 seat 2), up from 1.52, against 1.73-1.89 in y_47300 / y_47303. The petal pan (e1 seat 3) is still B/R 1.54 at L50 157.

priorIssues.issue: w12b-4 white shell rim and grey knobs along the back tops in the front view
priorIssues.evidence: q15top.png vs p00top.png: every near-row back still shows a ~5 px (about 1.2 cm at 430 px/m) white rim across the top, plus a round off-white knob at the top outer corner (the coat-hook gCyl at on(0.79, -0.035, 0.207)). In y_47300 the tops are fabric to the edge, with white only as a thin sliver on the sides and no knob. Note: the w12b claim that the back rises too far above the headrest does not hold. y_47306 shows the back ~0.2 seat-widths above the pad (render e4 0.12, q15 0.23), and y_47300's flush pads are more likely raised 6-way headrests.

issues.title: Diamond fabric: figure/ground inverted; light net with dark holes reads as rings
issues.evidence: Otsu light area 0.42 vs 0.21 (y_47306 L); light/dark 1.68 vs 2.25; blur p80/p20 1.26 vs 1.43; saturation 0.62 vs 0.49 (cmp_mos_diam.png).
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_diamond: set hd = rng.uniform(0.026, 0.031) so the figures separate, with the light area back near 0.2. Drop ~25 % of the sites at random (the w9 broken lattice) so they chain irregularly. Raise lift to about (3.4, 3.3, 2.9) to restore light/dark ~2.2. Set the ground to 1.0 * (tm + 0.4*(t - tm)). In SEATMAT yFabricB, ease the saturation to about #556699.

issues.title: Tick columns collapsed at row distance (the w12 dark lift)
issues.fix: make_swatches.py synth_y_tick: remove the dark lift (or drop it to 0.08) and raise the envelope to +-0.42. Brighten and saturate the tick highlights: r = r * (1 + 0.25*(r > 1.3*r.mean())) on the B channel. If the mip chain still averages the columns away, add a texture LOD bias of -0.5 for LAYER.yJacq in 03_tex.js (shared file, one line).

issues.title: Dash mosaic: empty block margins act as mortar; dashes too dim
issues.evidence: At a matched scale: light/dark 1.93 vs 2.58, p90/p50 1.44 vs 1.69; dark quartile #263157 vs #0d1b4b (mos_r13.png vs mos_photo.png).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_mosaic: start dashes at x0 + rng.uniform(-2, 2) and let them run up to x0 + cw + 2 (wrap with % n), over rows y0 .. y1 (no 1 px margins), so blocks show only as density changes. Set lift to about (6.5, 6.8, 7.2) and ground 0.75 * (...).

issues.title: White hood rim and coat-hook knobs visible across back tops head-on
issues.evidence: q15top.png vs p00top.png: ~1.2 cm white rim across every near-row back top, plus an off-white knob at the outer top corner. y_47300 shows fabric to the top edge.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js RS: pull the cap rows back. [0.855, 0.10 -> 0.112, ...] and [0.869, 0.078 -> 0.095, 0.058 -> 0.045, ...], so the cap sits behind the fabric crown (top SEC 0.862 at z 0.02 + 0.016 r). Alternatively raise the fabric crown's last two SECs by 8 mm so they hide the cap from an eye at ~1.6 m. Move the coat-hook knob to z further aft (-0.035 -> -0.06) or lower it (0.79 -> 0.72), so the fabric front hides it (side still unconfirmed, questions_econ 11).

issues.title: Head-on covers still a shade bright (seats 3/4)
issues.evidence: cover/back 0.96 / 0.97 vs 0.55 / 0.72 at the same seats in y_47300; cover L50 75 vs 42.
issues.fix: SEATMAT yCover: #343a58 and r 0.68. Alternatively tip the plate foot another 0.5 cm forward so the specular of the ceiling light leaves the q15 eye.

issues.title: Petal fleck: flecks dimmed too far, ground too flat
issues.evidence: q15 petal back p90/p50 1.57 vs 1.77, p10/p50 0.81 vs 0.63 (same bright fraction 0.217 vs 0.215-0.22). The petal pan is B/R 1.54 vs 1.73-1.89.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck: lift back to about (6.4, 5.9, 3.8) and ground = 0.86 + 0.14 * t/mean, so the weave shows between petals. In ECON_PAN, give petal pans the same saturated base as the tick pans (#44507c family).

issues.title: Headrest cover lacks stitched border, top fold and logo
issues.evidence: y_47306: the leatherette flap folds over the pad top with a visible lip, has a stitched seam ~1 cm in from the edge and a small wing logo at the lower right. The render's is a plain flat plate (e4).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js cover: add a 6 mm rounded lip at the top edge (gRBox 0.20 x 0.008 x 0.012, rotated over the pad), a 1 mm darker seam quad inset 1 cm, and a 12 mm atlas-free light-grey quad as the logo at the lower right.

issues.title: Screen sits proud; no recessed surround
issues.evidence: y_47305 / 47303: the screen sits in a shallow light-grey recessed bay with a sloped margin. The render's bezel is proud of a flat hood face (q18, e9).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: add a 6 mm sloped frame ring in yShellDark round the bezel, and set the bezel back by 4 mm.
